scope: Read-only identity/probe and capacity assessment; no musical changes, resequencing, sample copying, trimming or ROM export performed.
guard_assumption: 8192 samples per channel; stereo guard storage16384 bytes before per-channel16-byte alignment.
frame_policy: Capacity estimates use ceil video frames so no decoded source content is removed; tiny zero padding may be appended.
bitrate_note: MP3 bitrate is compressed source bitrate, not PCM precision. Stereo PCM options are signed8-bit per output lane.
vocal_note: No audio-listening or vocal detector is available. Contextual expectations are recorded and explicitly not machine-verified.

sources.decoded_duration_definition: All PCM returned by normal gapless ffmpeg decoding, with MP3 codec delay/padding handled by decoder metadata; no musical lead-in, video introduction, fade, silence or tail trimmed.

video_frame_rounding.recommended: Ceil video-frame duration and pad the end; nearest-frame rounding may cut the source by up to half a frame.
